extraction: Idemeum Four Gates Architecture: Gate 1 - Intent Screening (rejects off-topic, jailbreak, smuggled instructions). Gate 2 - Plan Validation (agent produces ordered plan validated against skill: allowed tools, diagnostics before fixes). Gate 3 - Policy Evaluation (checks plan against central policy: admin approval, forbidden actions, per-user rules). Gate 4 - Execution Gates (deterministic execution via code-reviewed tools only, AI never writes commands/scripts, audit every step). 5 Security Properties: plan as whitelist, AI never writes running code, consent as mechanism not courtesy, least privilege real boundaries. Model cannot skip or bypass any gate.
